info.title: Accord Analytics API
info.description: Read API over the indexed Accord treasury data. This file is the contract for the HTTP endpoints: `cargo test -p accord-analytics-api openapi` fails whenever it drifts from the router or the parameter validation in `analytics-api/src/main.rs`. Written by hand; see docs/ANALYTICS_API.md.

200.description: The service is up.
The datastore answered.
The process is serving requests.
The datastore answered within two seconds.

get.description: Per-dependency health used by the public status page. The overall status is `operational`, `degraded` or `outage`.

200.description: The service is operational or degraded.

get.description: Request, latency, rate-limit, cache and alert metrics in the Prometheus text format.

200.description: Prometheus text exposition format 0.0.4.

get.description: Per network and contract: ingestion lag (age of the indexer checkpoint) and report freshness (age of the last generated or delivered treasury report), each judged against its SLO, plus the API's own request latency (p50 and p95 since the process started, probes excluded; percentiles are histogram bucket upper bounds). SLOs come from SLO_INGESTION_LAG_SECS (default 120), SLO_API_P95_MS (default 500) and SLO_REPORT_MAX_AGE_SECS (default 32 days). A status is `ok`, `breach`, or `unknown` when there is nothing to judge yet. Live health, so it is not cached.

get.description: Follows every proposal created in the window through created → approved → executed, with cancelled (revoked) and expired proposals counted as the ways out. Each row is a cohort of proposals created in the window; rates are percentages (0–100). A proposal is approved once it reached its approval threshold, whatever became of it afterwards.

AlertRuleInput.description: The same rule object `ALERT_RULES` takes, plus `enabled`. `id` is required on create and may be left out on a replace or a test.

cooldownSecs.description: Overrides the deployment-wide cooldown for this rule.

token.description: `spend_threshold` only: limit the rule to one token.

threshold.description: `spend_threshold`: a positive integer in the token's smallest unit.

maxApprovals.description: `approval_burst`: approvals by one owner within the window that trigger an alert.

startHour.description: `off_hours_approval`: first UTC hour of the window; the window wraps past midnight when it is greater than endHour.

endHour.description: `off_hours_approval`: UTC hour the window ends (exclusive); must differ from startHour.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is evaluated. Defaults to true on create and keeps its value on replace.

cooldownSecs.description: Overrides the deployment-wide cooldown for this rule.

token.description: `spend_threshold` only: limit the rule to one token.

threshold.description: `spend_threshold`: a positive integer in the token's smallest unit.

maxApprovals.description: `approval_burst`: approvals by one owner within the window that trigger an alert.

startHour.description: `off_hours_approval`: first UTC hour of the window; the window wraps past midnight when it is greater than endHour.

endHour.description: `off_hours_approval`: UTC hour the window ends (exclusive); must differ from startHour.

source.description: `config` rules come from ALERT_RULES and are read-only.

truncated.description: A source had more events than a test reads (20000 per contract and network).

wouldFire.description: How many alerts the rule would have raised.

suppressed.description: Matches held back by the cooldown or storm cap.

ingestionLagSeconds.description: Seconds since the indexer checkpoint last advanced; null without a checkpoint.

reportAgeSeconds.description: Seconds since the last generated or delivered report; null when there is none.

status.description: The worse of ingestionStatus and reportStatus.
The worst status across the API and every pair in scope, not only this page.

adminBearer.description: The deployment's ADMIN_TOKEN. Only enforced when ADMIN_TOKEN is set.
